classification.difficultyReason: Combine a set and a complement using union and intersection of supplied shaded regions.

content.prompt: The two Venn diagrams show $A$ and $B'$.

spec.description: Left: all of A shaded grey. Right: everything outside B shaded grey. Headings A and B prime remain above their respective figures.
spec.mathematics: Compare membership of A and the complement of B.
spec.answerVisibility: Essential supplied shading remains visible in every edition.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Shade $A\cup B'$ by shading everything that is either in the first picture or in the second picture.

spec.description: Unshaded overlapping-set response diagram beneath the instruction.
spec.answerVisibility: No answer shading in the question.

answer.worked: Include all of $A$ and everything outside $B$. The only region in neither supplied shaded set is the part of $B$ outside $A$.

spec.description: Entire rectangle shaded light blue except B only.

children.label: b
children.prompt: Shade $A\cap B'$ by shading anything that is in both the first and second picture.

spec.description: Unshaded overlapping-set response diagram beneath the instruction.
spec.answerVisibility: No answer shading in the question.

answer.worked: The region shaded in both supplied pictures is inside $A$ and outside $B$. Shade the part of $A$ excluding the overlap.

spec.description: Only A outside B is shaded light blue.
